grounding_quotes.text: Get to your first invoice on Metronome
grounding_quotes.supports: The quickstart route is oriented toward reaching a first invoice.

grounding_quotes.text:
Set up Metronome to support charging your customers in arrears for
          only what they use.
grounding_quotes.supports: Pay-as-you-go is described as in-arrears billing for actual usage.

grounding_quotes.text:
Set up Metronome to support enterprise deal requirements like prepaid
          and postpaid commitments, negotiated discounts, one-time charges,
          contract renewals, and more.
grounding_quotes.supports: Enterprise commitments cover several negotiated commercial structures.

grounding_quotes.text:
Set up Metronome to combine recurring revenue with usage-based
          components.
grounding_quotes.supports: Subscriptions can combine recurring and usage-based components.

grounding_quotes.text:
Set up Metronome to allow customers to purchase a batch of credits
          upfront, with auto-recharge or gated access when credits run out.
grounding_quotes.supports: Prepaid credits can use auto-recharge or gated access after depletion.
